description: This file defines the interface `ModifyAttributesLiveCommand`, which provides functionalities for modifying attributes in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends other command interfaces and includes a method to retrieve the attributes to modify.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command for modifying attributes, providing access to the attributes to modify and extending command interfaces for live commands and thing modification.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the Attributes object that specifies the attributes to be modified.
